channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Roman temple stones used in village houses
item.description: In a village on the Paphlagonia Route in the northern province of Kastamonu, stones from a 1,750-year-old Roman temple adorn the walls and foundations of many homes.

item.title: Istanbul court postpones hearing in İmamoğlu’s diploma case to July 6
item.description: An Istanbul criminal court on Feb. 16 adjourned the hearing in the case against Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu regarding allegations of official document forgery and an invalid university diploma to July 6, despite widespread anticipation that the prosecutor would deliver their final opinion.

item.title: Turkish FM holds talks with Saudi, Iraqi officials
item.description: Türkiye’s top diplomat held a series of diplomatic contacts with regional counterparts and officials to discuss bilateral ties and regional developments, Foreign Ministry sources said on Feb. 16.

item.title: Justice Minister pledges leadership based on consultation, ground realities
item.description: Türkiye’s Justice Minister Akın Gürlek has delivered a message to members of the judiciary, presenting a leadership approach centered on consultation, close engagement with realities on the ground and data-driven decision-making, while outlining key reform priorities for the country’s judicial system.

item.title: Türkiye remains to be an island of stability amid regional mess: Bahçeli
item.description: Despite growing global and regional geopolitical chaos, Türkiye remains to be an island of stability thanks to the active and smart diplomacy implemented by the Turkish government, Nationalist Movement Party (MHP) Chairman Devlet Bahçeli has said.

item.title: Galatasaray stuns Juventus 5-2 in Champions League
item.description: Galatasaray pushed Juventus to the brink of elimination from the Champions League in a wild 5-2 comeback win in Istanbul on Tuesday.

item.title: Turkish cosmetics sector rides ‘Turkish Beauty’ wave to global growth
item.description: Türkiye’s cosmetics industry is reaping the rewards of its “Turkish Beauty” strategy, launched in 2006, with exports reaching $2.33 billion in 2025—a year-on-year increase of 11.8 percent.

item.title: Türkiye welcomes Ramadan with journey of faith, unity
item.description: Türkiye warmly welcomes the Islamic holy month of Ramadan with a profound sense of spiritual renewal and communal grace as millions of Muslims across the country prepare to honor enduring rituals and the first sacred fast at dawn on Feb. 19.

item.title: Ukraine war talks to resume in Geneva with no sign of progress
item.description: Ukrainian and Russian negotiators were to resume a second round of U.S.-mediated peace talks in Geneva on Wednesday, though neither side signalled they were any closer to ending Europe's deadliest conflict since World War II.

item.title: Iran upbeat after US talks but Vance says 'red lines' not met
item.description: Iran said Tuesday it had agreed with the United States in talks in Geneva on "guiding principles" for a deal to avoid conflict, but Vice President JD Vance said Tehran had not yet acknowledged all of Washington's red lines.
